Banner final class

CommandSpec final class

Declarative description of a command: its options, subcommands, the rules between options (requires, conflicts) and how many positional arguments it takes. parse() turns an argv list into ParsedArgs or a UsageError. It is the single input the generators read too: HelpText::fromSpec() for the help page, Completion::script() for bash, zsh and fish completions, and Manpage::render() for the man page.

Not listed: the methods of SugarCraft\Core\Concerns\Mutable, a trait declared outside src/.

MethodSummary
static new(string $name): self
withDescription(string $description): selfOne-line summary for help and completion output.
withOption(Option $option): selfDeclare an option. Long and short names must be unique on this command.
withSubcommand(CommandSpec $subcommand): selfDeclare a subcommand, selected by its name as the first positional.
conflicts(string ...$options): selfAt most one of these options may be given. Options supplied on argv also silence the environment fallback of the others in the set, so an exported variable never makes an explicit command line invalid.
requires(string $option, string ...$required): selfWhen $option is given (argv or env), each of $required must be too. Repeated calls for one option add to its list.
withMinArguments(int $min): selfFewest positional arguments accepted.
withMaxArguments(?int $max): selfMost positional arguments accepted; null is unbounded. When never called, a command with subcommands accepts none, so a mistyped subcommand is reported as one instead of being taken as an argument; an explicit null keeps such a command unbounded.
name(): string
description(): string
options(): arrayDeclared options, keyed by long name, in declaration order. PHP turns an all-digit name such as 5 into an int key; read the name from Option::name() when a string is needed.
option(string $name): ?OptionThe option with this long name, or null.
subcommands(): arrayDeclared subcommands, keyed by name, in declaration order. An all-digit name comes back as an int key; read the name from CommandSpec::name() when a string is needed.
subcommand(string $name): ?CommandSpecThe subcommand with this name, or null.
groups(): arrayOptions grouped for help output: group name => options, groups in order of first appearance; the ungrouped options sit under ''. PHP turns an all-digit group name such as 2024 into an int key; cast the key with (string) or read Option::group() when a string is needed.
conflictSets(): array
requirements(): array
minArguments(): int
maxArguments(): ?intThe configured maximum, or null when unbounded or never set (see effectiveMaxArguments()).
effectiveMaxArguments(): ?intThe maximum parse() enforces: the configured one, else 0 with subcommands, else unbounded (null).
parse(array $argv, ?array $env = null): ParsedArgs|UsageErrorParse an argument list against this spec.

Option final class

One declared command-line option of a CommandSpec: a flag (--verbose) or a value option (--model gpt), with its short alias, environment fallback, value type, allowed values, default and help group.

Not listed: the methods of SugarCraft\Core\Concerns\Mutable, a trait declared outside src/.

MethodSummary
static flag(string $name): selfA switch with no value: --name (or -x once withShort() is set).
static value(string $name): selfAn option that takes one value: --name value or --name=value.
withShort(string $short): selfSingle-character alias, used as -x. Letters and digits only.
withEnv(string $env): selfEnvironment variable read when the option is absent from argv. An empty variable counts as unset.
withDescription(string $description): selfOne-line help text.
withType(ValueType $type): selfConvert the raw value into an int or float; a value that does not convert is a usage error. Only meaningful on a value option.
withChoices(array $choices): selfRestrict the value to a fixed set of strings (compared exactly). Replaces any withEnum() binding.
withEnum(string $enum): selfRestrict the value to the backing values of a backed enum; the parsed value is the enum case, not the string.
withRepeatable(bool $repeatable = true): selfAccept the option more than once. A repeatable value option collects a list; a repeatable flag counts its occurrences (-vvv is 3). A non-repeatable option given twice keeps the last value.
withRequired(bool $required = true): selfFail with a usage error when neither argv nor the env variable supplies the option. A default never satisfies it, so CommandSpec::withOption() rejects an option with both.
withDefault(mixed $default): selfValue reported when neither argv nor env supplies the option. Taken as given: it is not converted or checked against the choices. On a repeatable value option a non-array default is wrapped in a list, and on a repeatable flag a bool default becomes a count (true is 1). Not allowed on a required option (withRequired()).
withGroup(string $group): selfHelp-page section this option is listed under; '' is the ungrouped section.
withValueName(string $valueName): selfPlaceholder for the value in help output, e.g. --model <MODEL>.
withPersistent(bool $persistent = true): selfAlso accept this option after any subcommand of the command that declares it.
name(): stringLong name, without the leading --.
kind(): OptionKind
takesValue(): boolTrue for a value option, false for a flag.
short(): ?stringShort alias without the -, or null.
env(): ?stringFallback environment variable, or null.
description(): string
type(): ValueType
choices(): arrayAllowed raw values; empty means any value.
enum(): ?stringBacked enum the value maps to, or null.
repeatable(): bool
required(): bool
default(): mixedThe configured default, or null when none was set.
group(): string
valueName(): stringValue placeholder for help output; defaults to the upper-cased name.
persistent(): bool
display(): string--name, the spelling used in usage errors and help.

OptionKind enum

Whether an Option is a bare switch or carries a value.

ParsedArgs final class

The successful result of CommandSpec::parse(): the selected command path, the resolved value and source of every option in that command's parse, and the positional arguments.

MethodSummary
static new(array $command, array $values, array $sources, array $arguments): self
command(): arraySelected command path, root first (['git', 'remote', 'add']).
has(string $name): boolTrue when the option came from argv or its env variable (a default does not count).
value(string $name): mixedResolved value of an option by long name.
source(string $name): ?ValueSourceWhere the value came from, or null when nothing (not even a default) supplied one.
values(): arrayResolved value of every option in this command's parse (see the class docblock), keyed by long name. PHP turns an all-digit name such as 5 into an int key; cast it with (string) before passing it on as a name.
arguments(): arrayPositional arguments in order, including everything after --.

Render a section header — a label sandwiched between two horizontal rules: ── LABEL ──────────────. Common in CLI output where you want to break long stretches of stdout into named groups.

Theme final class

Per-status palette for the presenters that take one — StatusLine, Banner, Section, Stage and HelpText (every one of them falls back to detect() when handed no theme, per below). Themes are immutable; ansi() ships the default colourful palette, plain() produces a no-op palette ideal for snapshot tests, and the named presets in PRESET_NAMES (charm, dracula, nord, catppuccin, plus auto) cover the most-requested branded palettes.

Not listed: the methods of SugarCraft\Core\Concerns\Mutable, a trait declared outside src/.

MethodSummary
__construct(public readonly Style $success, public readonly Style $error, public readonly Style $warn, public readonly Style $info, public readonly Style $prompt, public readonly Style $accent, public readonly Style $muted)All seven slots are non-nullable: a theme without a style for a level is an illegal state, so the type system enforces it at the boundary (strict_types turns a null argument into a TypeError) instead of a hand-rolled constructor loop.
static ansi(): self
static detect(?array $env = null, mixed $stream = null): selfThe ansi() palette downgraded to the colour capability of the output stream — the fallback every presenter uses when no theme is passed.
withColorProfile(ColorProfile $profile): selfDowngrade every style in this theme to $profile.
static plain(): self
static auto(?BackgroundColorMsg $bg = null): selfTerminal-adaptive factory — picks a dark or light theme by checking the terminal background colour.
static build(): ThemeBuilderBegin building a custom theme with a fluent interface.
static charm(): selfCharm-brand pink + cyan accent set.
static dracula(): selfDracula palette — hex literals re-sourced from sugar-core's Palettes::DRACULA single-source-of-truth so they no longer drift as they are hand-copied around the monorepo.
static nord(): selfNord palette — cool blues and frost tones.
static catppuccin(): selfCatppuccin Mocha — pastel set.
static byName(string $name): selfResolve a theme by name. Presets: 'ansi', 'plain', 'charm', 'dracula', 'nord', 'catppuccin', and 'auto' (the adaptive factory with no background msg — the ansi() fallback). Case-insensitive.
static detectFor(mixed $stream): selfDetect for one named stream — the entry point for callers that already know their destination (a file handle, a pty master) and want the detect() downgrade without going through the default-stream substitution.
